source: https://www.liblib.tv/ (workspace home, logged out) + https://www.liblib.tv/creation/process?id=… (read-only canvas and 故事板 view)

image_ratios.ratio: 16:9 thumbnails, 5 per row, duration badge top-right

taste.name: One giant verb, then shortcuts
taste.trigger: When a returning creator lands on the workspace home
taste.decision: Chose a single 1120x160 '新建画布创作' card with one + button, followed by a row of 8 equal model/tool tiles, over a dashboard of stats, onboarding checklists or project tables
taste.reason: The only thing a creator wants on arrival is to start making; everything else (models, past work, community) is a shortcut into that same act
evidence: new-canvas card 1120x160 at the top of the content column
8 tiles 133x86 with 98x56 icon boxes rgba(255,255,255,0.05), radius 16px
no numbers or charts on the home

taste.name: Grey chrome, media carries the color
taste.trigger: When the workspace is full of thumbnails and generated clips
taste.decision: Chose four near-black neutrals (#121212/#141414/#171717 + 5-6% white surfaces) and #F7F7F7/#A8A8A8 text, keeping the single cyan #04CAF6 for tiny badges, over themed panels or colored section headers
taste.reason: Hundreds of colorful thumbnails already compete; neutral chrome lets a creator judge the output's color without a tinted frame around it
evidence: cyan appears only on 11-12px badges with a 12% tint background

taste.name: Assets sorted by role, not by date
taste.trigger: When a project has dozens of generated images and clips
taste.decision: Chose a 故事板 view that groups images into 角色 / 场景 / 物品 tabs and videos into 视频片段 / 成片, with duration badges, over one chronological stream
taste.reason: A creator assembling a shot asks 'which character sheet / which scene plate', so the asset wall answers in those terms — the same roles the generation prompts reference
evidence: 图片 43 with tabs 全部/角色/场景/物品/其他
视频 16 with tabs 全部/视频片段/成片 and '4秒/14秒' badges
文本 and 音频 (背景音乐 03:06, 旁白音色 00:02) in a left rail

taste.name: Dense UI, no decoration
taste.trigger: When choosing the density of a pro tool
taste.decision: Chose 11-14px system type, a 4px spacing base and zero shadows over a spacious marketing-style UI
taste.reason: Creators keep the workspace open for hours next to large media; small, quiet controls leave the pixels to the work
evidence: font sizes 14/13/12/11 cover 101 of 118 text nodes
4px is the most common spacing (107 uses)
